title: Frontier Radar #4: China has caught up, so what's left of the Western AI lead?
summary: Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 are now within striking distance of the best US models. Western labs blame distillation, and there's real evidence for it. But guilty or not, the conclusion is the same: a model lead can't be defended. This issue looks at what can.
